query_plan.query: Which UCL club has the most social media followers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by club id, select the club with the highest number of social media followers.
steps.query: Return all UCL clubs together with their number of social media followers.

extra.sql_query: SELECT name FROM ucl_clubs WHERE socialFollowers = (SELECT MAX(socialFollowers) FROM ucl_clubs)

s1.sql_query: SELECT ucl_clubs.team, ucl_clubs.name, ucl_clubs.socialFollowers FROM ucl_clubs
